item.title: Hamilton is Ferrari’s first new driver in 44 years to complete season without a podium | Formula 1
item.description: Lewis Hamilton's first season at Ferrari came to a disappointing end in Yas Marina as he failed to finish on the podium in the grand prix again.

item.title: “You made a kid’s dream come true!” Norris thanks team through tears after winning title | Formula 1
item.description: After winning the world championship Lando Norris told his race engineer: "You said you'd cry if we didn't win, but I hope you're crying because we did."

item.title: Bearman two penalty points away from automatic race ban after Stroll incident | Formula 1
item.description: Oliver Bearman will go into next year's season just two penalty points away from an automatic ban following an incident with Lance Stroll in today's race.

item.title: Brown thanks “team player” Piastri after Norris clinches title in Yas Marina | Formula 1
item.description: McLaren Racing CEO Zak Brown thanked Oscar Piastri for being a "team player" after Lando Norris won the world championship.

item.title: Verstappen says losing title by two points “looks painful” but he’s “not too sad” | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen said he isn't too disappointed after falling short of a fifth consecutive championship victory by just two points.

item.title: Verstappen hits out at suggestion his collision with Russell cost him the title | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen was unhappy to be reminded of his collision with George Russell in Spain after falling two points short of winning the world championship.

item.title: Tsunoda complains stewards gave him a ‘strange penalty – as usual for them’ | Formula 1
item.description: Yuki Tsunoda criticised the stewards for his penalty while Lando Norris said his race would have been over if they had been five centimetres closer.

item.title: Verstappen explains why he didn’t try to back up Norris into other cars | 2025 Abu Dhabi GP interactive data
item.description: Max Verstappen said Oscar Piastri's strategy made it harder for him to hold up Lando Norris in the hope of beating him to the world championship.

item.title: Norris proud he has ‘won the title my way, trying to be a good person’ | Formula 1
item.description: Lando Norris says his world championship triumph vindicated his approach to racing in Formula 1 and showed he did not need to be more like his rivals.

item.title: Round-up: Sainz congratulates “my muppet friend” on title, and more | RaceFans Round-up
item.description: Monday's edition of the RaceFans round-up.
